City Council
AGENDA
la puente City Council
COUNCIL CHAMBERS
15900 EAST MAIN STREET, LA PUENTE
MARCH 13, 2007
07:00
P.M.
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
COUNCILMEMBERS: Solis, Lujan, Chavez, Storing, Perez
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
PRESENTATIONS
PRESENTATION OF COMMENDATION TO FORMER PLANNING COMMISSIONER GEORGE GAYTAN
PRESENTATION BY RAHUL KUMAR DIRECTOR OF PLANNING FROM FOOTHILL TRANSIT REGARDING THE NEW SILVER STREAK SERVICE
PRESENTATION OF COMMENDATION TO THE LA PUENTE NATIONAL LITTLE LEAGUE IN HONOR OF ITS 50TH ANNIVERSARY
PRESENTATION BY RAINBOW YEUNG FROM AIR QUALITY MANAGEMENT DISTRICT (AQMD) REGARDING PRESERVATION OF SUPPLY OF CLEAN NATURAL GAS TO PREVENT AIR POLLUTION
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
If you wish to address the City Council on an item other than a public hearing matter, please complete the Request for Oral Presentation form and submit it to the City Clerk no later than prior to the conclusion of the first speaker's remarks. (Ordinance No. 98-767).
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS MEETINGS
A-1
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING OF FEBRUARY 27, 2007
It is recommended that the City Council waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the Regular Meeting of February 27, 2007.
PUBLIC HEARINGS
None.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS
C-1
CONSIDERATION OF APPOINTMENT OF PLANNING COMMISSIONER
Vote for one candidate for the Planning Commission. Candidate must receive at least three votes to be appointed.
C-2
CONSIDERATION OF LANDSCAPE OF CITY OWNED AREAS
It is recommended that the City Council provide Staff with direction regarding: (1) Abbey Street slope; (2) Hacienda Boulevard and Nelson corner; and (3) the other areas listed in the report.
CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF RESOLUTION APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NO. 1198 FOR FISCAL YEAR 2006-07
It is recommended that the City Council adopt the resolution.
D-4
PROPOSED AMENDMENT TO FISCAL YEAR 2006-2007 BUDGET FOR CONTRACT SERVICES WITH MORELAND & ASSOCIATES FOR TEMPORARY PERSONNEL SERVICES
It is recommended that the City Council review and adopt the Resolution to increase the Fiscal Year 2006-2007 Budget by $4,320 in 11-4160-3111-70, Contract Services-Private.
D-5
CONSIDERATION OF AMENDMENT TO THE SENIOR CENTER IMPROVEMENTS PROJECT
Staff recommends that Council approve the addition of items to the Senior Center work scope and authorize the City Manager to execute the necessary documents to implement the addition/repairs.
D-2
CONSIDERATION OF APPROVING EMPLOYEE SERVICE AWARD AND EMPLOYEE OF THE MONTH POLICIES
It is recommended that the City Council adopt the Employee Service Award and Employee of the Month policies.
NEW BUSINESS
E-1
CONSIDERATION OF RESOLUTION APPROVING VALLEY VISTA SOLID WASTE COLLECTION SERVICE RATE INCREASE REQUEST
It is recommended that the City Council adopt a Resolution approving Valley Vista Services' request for a rate increase for solid waste collection services based on the documented increases in the cost to provide waste services to the City of La Puente.
E-2
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION SUPPORTING THE AIR QUALITY MANAGEMENT DISTRICT'S DRAFT 2007 AIR QUALITY MANAGEMENT PLAN AND LETTER OF SUPPORT
It is recommended that the City Council adopt a resolution supporting the development of the South Coast Air Quality Management District's (AQMD) Air Quality Management Plan and authorize Staff to send the resolution and letter of support to AQMD.
E-3
CONSIDERATION OF REPLACEMENT OF THREE PART-TIME COMMUNITY PRESERVATION OFFICER POSITIONS WITH ONE FULL-TIME POSITION
Staff recommends that the City Council direct Staff to prepare a draft resolution that will amend the comprehensive personnel system deleting the part-time Community Preservation Officer positions and establishing a new full-time Parking Control Officer position.
E-4
CONSIDERATION OF ADOPTING A RESOLUTION FOR REPAYMENT OF COSTS INCURRED IN MAKING EMERGENCY REPAIRS TO THE HILLSIDE LOCATED AT 133 ROUNDABOUT DR., 139 ROUNDABOUT DR., 140 HILLCREST DR. AND 148 HILLCREST DR.
It is recommended that the City Council adopt the Resolution confirming the costs incurred by the City in remeditating the damage to the properties involved and directing Staff to record liens on the respective properties based on the terms outlined in this report.
COUNCIL AB1234 REPORTS
ORAL COMMENTS FROM COUNCIL
ORAL COMMENTS FROM STAFF
ADJOURNMENT
Copies of reports relating to items on the Agenda are available for public inspection or purchase at City Hall. Questions regarding agenda items may be addressed to the City Clerk at 626/855-1500, extension 538. In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services offered by the City, please contact the City Clerk's Office. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
* Meetings of the City Council shall be adjourned no later than 10:30 p.m., unless a motion to supersede the 10:30 time limit to consider some or all of the remaining items listed on the Agenda, or to consider items which have been added to the Agenda in accordance with the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act, Government Code Section 54950, et seq., is approved by a majority of the members of the City Council. (Ordinance No. 95-727, effective September 7, 1995.)

CERTIFICATION

City Council
MINUTES
LA PUENTE CITY COUNCIL
REGULAR MEETING OF
March 13, 2007
A Regular Meeting of the City Council of the City of La Puente was held in the Council Chambers of City Hall, 15900 East Main Street, La Puente, California, on March 13, 2007, at 07:00 p.m.
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
PRESENTATIONS

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS

A-1
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING OF FEBRUARY 27, 2007
Solis moved to approve the minutes of the regular meeting of February 27, 2007; seconded by Chavez.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Solis, Storing, Chavez, and Perez. NOES: None.
PUBLIC HEARINGS
UNFINISHED BUSINESS
C-1
CONSIDERATION OF APPOINTMENT OF PLANNING COMMISSIONER
C-2
CONSIDERATION OF LANDSCAPE OF CITY OWNED AREAS
Perez moved to authorize staff to landscape the Nelson/Hacienda site for Fiscal Year 2006-2007 and the Abbey street landscape site to be considered in Fiscal Year 2007-2008 ; seconded by Solis.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Solis, Storing, Chavez, and Perez. NOES: None.
CONSENT CALENDAR
Action Taken :
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
Chavez moved to approve Consent Calendar Items No. D-1, D-4, and D-5; seconded by Perez.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Solis, Storing, Chavez, and Perez. NOES: None.
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF RESOLUTION APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NO. 1198 FOR FISCAL YEAR 2006-07
D-4

Storing moved to adopt the Employee Service Award and Employee of the Month policy and to increase the $20 dollar gift certificate to $100 ; seconded by Chavez.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Solis, Storing, Chavez, and Perez. NOES: None.
NEW BUSINESS
E-1
CONSIDERATION OF RESOLUTION APPROVING VALLEY VISTA SOLID WASTE COLLECTION SERVICE RATE INCREASE REQUEST
moved to ; seconded by .
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Solis, Storing, and Perez. NOES: None.
E-2
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION SUPPORTING THE AIR QUALITY MANAGEMENT DISTRICT'S DRAFT 2007 AIR QUALITY MANAGEMENT PLAN AND LETTER OF SUPPORT
moved to ; seconded by .
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Solis, Storing, Chavez, and Perez. NOES: None.
E-3
CONSIDERATION OF REPLACEMENT OF THREE PART-TIME COMMUNITY PRESERVATION OFFICER POSITIONS WITH ONE FULL-TIME POSITION
Perez moved to direct Staff to prepare a draft resolution that will amend the comprehensive personnel system deleting the part-time Community Preservation Officer positions and establishing a new full-time Parking Control Officer position ; seconded by Solis.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Solis, Storing, Chavez, and Perez. NOES: None.
E-4
CONSIDERATION OF ADOPTING A RESOLUTION FOR REPAYMENT OF COSTS INCURRED IN MAKING EMERGENCY REPAIRS TO THE HILLSIDE LOCATED AT 133 ROUNDABOUT DR., 139 ROUNDABOUT DR., 140 HILLCREST DR. AND 148 HILLCREST DR.
Perez moved to adopt the Resolution confirming the costs incurred by the City in remeditating the damage to the properties involved and directing Staff to record liens on the respective properties based on the terms outlined in the report; seconded by Storing.
